fa.#How confident are you in your ability t: در پیش‌بینی و واکنش به موقعیت‌های خطرناک هنگام استفاده از دوچرخه یا اسکوتر برقی چقدر به توانایی خود اطمینان دارید؟ مثلاً باز شدن ناگهانی در خودرو، پیچیدن خودرو جلوی شما یا تقاطع با دید محدود.
fa.#A junction with poor visibility is one: تقاطع با دید محدود تقاطعی است که در آن ساختمان‌ها، دیوارها یا خودروهای پارک‌شده ترافیکی را که از کنار می‌آید پنهان می‌کنند.
fa.#Not confident at all — I feel unprepare: اصلاً مطمئن نیستم — برای این موقعیت‌ها آماده نیستم
fa.#Slightly confident — I am aware of the: کمی مطمئنم — خطرها را می‌شناسم اما اغلب غافلگیر می‌شوم
fa.#Fairly confident — I manage most situat: نسبتاً مطمئنم — بیشتر موقعیت‌ها را مدیریت می‌کنم، اما بعضی هنوز نگرانم می‌کنند
fa.#Very confident — I anticipate most haza: خیلی مطمئنم — بیشتر خطرها را از قبل تشخیص می‌دهم و خوب واکنش نشان می‌دهم
fa.#Completely confident — I feel well prep: کاملاً مطمئنم — برای خطرهای معمول آمادگی خوبی دارم

hu.#How confident are you in your ability t: Mennyire bízik abban, hogy kerékpározás vagy rollerezés közben előre felismeri és kezeli a veszélyes helyzeteket, például hirtelen kinyíló autóajtót, elé forduló járművet vagy beláthatatlan kereszteződést?
hu.#A junction with poor visibility is one: Beláthatatlan kereszteződés az, ahol épületek, falak vagy parkoló járművek eltakarják az oldalról érkező forgalmat.
hu.#Not confident at all — I feel unprepare: Egyáltalán nem vagyok magabiztos — nem érzem magam felkészültnek ezekre a helyzetekre
hu.#Slightly confident — I am aware of the: Kissé magabiztos vagyok — ismerem a kockázatokat, de gyakran váratlanul érnek
hu.#Fairly confident — I manage most situat: Elég magabiztos vagyok — a legtöbb helyzetet kezelem, de néhány még aggaszt
hu.#Very confident — I anticipate most haza: Nagyon magabiztos vagyok — a legtöbb veszélyt előre észreveszem és megfelelően reagálok
hu.#Completely confident — I feel well prep: Teljesen magabiztos vagyok — jól felkészültnek érzem magam a tipikus veszélyekre

ar.#How confident are you in your ability t: ما مدى ثقتك في قدرتك على توقع المواقف الخطرة والتعامل معها أثناء ركوب الدراجة أو السكوتر الكهربائي، مثل فتح باب سيارة فجأة أو قطع مركبة لطريقك أو تقاطع محدود الرؤية؟
ar.#A junction with poor visibility is one: التقاطع محدود الرؤية هو تقاطع تحجب فيه المباني أو الجدران أو المركبات المتوقفة حركة المرور القادمة من الجانب.
ar.#Not confident at all — I feel unprepare: لست واثقًا إطلاقًا — لا أشعر أنني مستعد لهذه المواقف
ar.#Slightly confident — I am aware of the: واثق قليلًا — أعرف المخاطر لكنني أفاجأ بها كثيرًا
ar.#Fairly confident — I manage most situat: واثق إلى حد ما — أتعامل مع معظم المواقف لكن بعضها ما زال يقلقني
ar.#Very confident — I anticipate most haza: واثق جدًا — أتوقع معظم المخاطر وأستجيب جيدًا
ar.#Completely confident — I feel well prep: واثق تمامًا — أشعر أنني مستعد جيدًا للمخاطر المعتادة

schema.text: What improvements would most encourage you to ride a bicycle or e-scooter more often or for longer distances?
schema.help: A physically separated cycle lane is divided from motor traffic by a kerb, posts or a barrier, not only by a painted line.

Better road surface quality on cycling routes
More secure parking for bicycles and e-scooters, at destinations and near home
Reduced vehicle speeds in residential areas
More trees and shade along cycling routes
Better street lighting on cycling routes
Safe riding courses for bicycles or e-scooters
Financial incentives (e.g., employer cycling allowance, subsidised bike purchase)

Nothing — I am satisfied with current conditions

it.#More dedicated and physically separated: Più piste ciclabili dedicate e fisicamente separate dal traffico
it.#Better road surface quality on cycling: Migliore qualità della pavimentazione lungo i percorsi ciclabili
it.#More secure parking for bicycles and e-: Più parcheggi sicuri per biciclette e monopattini, presso le destinazioni e vicino a casa
it.#Reduced vehicle speeds in residential a: Riduzione della velocità dei veicoli nelle aree residenziali
it.#Better cycle-friendly junctions and cro: Incroci e attraversamenti più adatti ai ciclisti

it.#Better street lighting on cycling route: Migliore illuminazione stradale lungo i percorsi ciclabili
it.#Safe riding courses for bicycles or e-s: Corsi di guida sicura in bici o in monopattino

it.#Being able to take a bicycle or e-scoot: Poter portare la bicicletta o il monopattino su autobus, tram, metro o treni

fr.#Better road surface quality on cycling: Une meilleure qualité de chaussée sur les itinéraires cyclables
fr.#More secure parking for bicycles and e-: Davantage de stationnements sûrs pour vélos et trottinettes, à destination et près du domicile
fr.#Reduced vehicle speeds in residential a: Une vitesse plus faible des véhicules dans les zones résidentielles
fr.#Better cycle-friendly junctions and cro: Des carrefours et traversées mieux adaptés aux cyclistes
fr.#More trees and shade along cycling rout: Davantage d’arbres et d’ombre le long des itinéraires cyclables
fr.#Better street lighting on cycling route: Un meilleur éclairage public sur les itinéraires cyclables
fr.#Safe riding courses for bicycles or e-s: Des cours de conduite sûre à vélo ou en trottinette
fr.#Financial incentives (e.g., employer cy: Des aides financières (par exemple une indemnité vélo de l’employeur ou une aide à l’achat d’un vélo)

fr.#A larger sharing service with more bicy: Un service de libre-service plus étendu, avec plus de vélos, de trottinettes ou de stations
fr.#Continuous cycle routes connecting neig: Des itinéraires cyclables continus reliant les quartiers

de.#Financial incentives (e.g., employer cy: Finanzielle Anreize (zum Beispiel Zuschuss vom Arbeitgeber oder Förderung beim Fahrradkauf)

de.#Being able to take a bicycle or e-scoot: Fahrrad oder E-Scooter in Bussen, Straßenbahnen, U-Bahnen oder Zügen mitnehmen können

tr.#What improvements would most encourage: Hangi iyileştirmeler daha sık veya daha uzun mesafelerde bisiklet ya da elektrikli scooter kullanmanızı en çok teşvik ederdi?

tr.#More secure parking for bicycles and e-: Varış noktalarında ve evin yakınında bisiklet ve elektrikli scooterlar için daha fazla güvenli park yeri
tr.#Reduced vehicle speeds in residential a: Yerleşim bölgelerinde daha düşük araç hızları
tr.#Better cycle-friendly junctions and cro: Bisikletliler için daha iyi kavşaklar ve geçişler
tr.#More trees and shade along cycling rout: Bisiklet güzergâhlarında daha fazla ağaç ve gölge
tr.#Better street lighting on cycling route: Bisiklet güzergâhlarında daha iyi sokak aydınlatması
tr.#Safe riding courses for bicycles or e-s: Bisiklet veya elektrikli scooter için güvenli sürüş kursları

fa.#More dedicated and physically separated: مسیرهای دوچرخه بیشتر و جداشده از ترافیک
fa.#Better road surface quality on cycling: کیفیت بهتر سطح خیابان در مسیرهای دوچرخه
fa.#More secure parking for bicycles and e-: پارک امن بیشتر برای دوچرخه و اسکوتر برقی، در مقصدها و نزدیک خانه
fa.#Reduced vehicle speeds in residential a: سرعت کمتر خودروها در مناطق مسکونی
fa.#Better cycle-friendly junctions and cro: تقاطع‌ها و گذرگاه‌های بهتر برای دوچرخه
fa.#More trees and shade along cycling rout: درخت و سایه بیشتر در مسیرهای دوچرخه
fa.#Better street lighting on cycling route: روشنایی بهتر خیابان در مسیرهای دوچرخه

fa.#Nothing — I am satisfied with current c: هیچ‌کدام — از شرایط فعلی راضی هستم

fa.#Continuous cycle routes connecting neig: مسیرهای پیوستهٔ دوچرخه که محله‌ها را به هم وصل کنند
fa.#Being able to take a bicycle or e-scoot: امکان بردن دوچرخه یا اسکوتر برقی در اتوبوس، تراموا، مترو یا قطار

hu.#What improvements would most encourage: Mely fejlesztések ösztönöznék leginkább arra, hogy gyakrabban vagy hosszabb távon használjon kerékpárt vagy elektromos rollert?
hu.#A physically separated cycle lane is di: A fizikailag elválasztott kerékpársávot nemcsak felfestett vonal, hanem szegély, oszlopok vagy korlát választja el a gépjárműforgalomtól.
hu.#More dedicated and physically separated: Több külön, fizikailag is elválasztott kerékpársáv
hu.#More secure parking for bicycles and e-: Több biztonságos parkolóhely kerékpároknak és rollereknek az úti céloknál és az otthon közelében
hu.#More trees and shade along cycling rout: Több fa és árnyék a kerékpáros útvonalakon
hu.#Safe riding courses for bicycles or e-s: Biztonságos közlekedési tanfolyamok kerékpárral vagy rollerrel
hu.#Financial incentives (e.g., employer cy: Pénzügyi ösztönzők (például munkáltatói kerékpáros támogatás vagy vásárlási támogatás)
hu.#Nothing — I am satisfied with current c: Semmi — elégedett vagyok a jelenlegi körülményekkel
hu.#A larger sharing service with more bicy: Kiterjedtebb megosztási szolgáltatás több kerékpárral, rollerrel vagy állomással
hu.#Continuous cycle routes connecting neig: A városrészeket összekötő, összefüggő kerékpáros útvonalak
hu.#Being able to take a bicycle or e-scoot: Lehetőség a kerékpár vagy roller szállítására buszon, villamoson, metrón vagy vonaton

ar.#What improvements would most encourage: ما التحسينات التي ستشجعك أكثر على استخدام الدراجة أو السكوتر الكهربائي بصورة أكثر أو لمسافات أطول؟
ar.#A physically separated cycle lane is di: حارة الدراجات المنفصلة فعليًا يفصلها عن حركة المركبات رصيف أو أعمدة أو حاجز، وليس مجرد خط مرسوم.

ar.#More secure parking for bicycles and e-: المزيد من أماكن الركن الآمنة للدراجات والسكوترات الكهربائية عند الوجهات وبالقرب من المنزل
ar.#Reduced vehicle speeds in residential a: خفض سرعة المركبات في المناطق السكنية
ar.#More trees and shade along cycling rout: المزيد من الأشجار والظل على طرق الدراجات
ar.#Better street lighting on cycling route: إضاءة شارع أفضل على طرق الدراجات
ar.#Safe riding courses for bicycles or e-s: دورات للقيادة الآمنة بالدراجة أو السكوتر الكهربائي
ar.#Financial incentives (e.g., employer cy: حوافز مالية (مثل بدل دراجة من جهة العمل أو دعم لشراء دراجة)
ar.#Nothing — I am satisfied with current c: لا شيء — أنا راضٍ عن الظروف الحالية
ar.#A larger sharing service with more bicy: خدمة مشاركة أوسع مع المزيد من الدراجات أو السكوترات أو المحطات
ar.#Continuous cycle routes connecting neig: مسارات دراجات متصلة تربط بين الأحياء
ar.#Being able to take a bicycle or e-scoot: إمكانية اصطحاب الدراجة أو السكوتر الكهربائي في الحافلات أو الترام أو المترو أو القطارات

schema.text: How adequate is the cycling infrastructure (cycle lanes, paths, and signage) on your typical route?

options.text: Very adequate — cycling infrastructure is excellent throughout my route
Mostly adequate — infrastructure is reasonably good along most of my route
Partially adequate — infrastructure covers part of my route
Inadequate — some provision exists but it is fragmented or poorly designed
Very inadequate — little or no cycling infrastructure exists

en.#How adequate is the cycling infrastruct: How adequate is the cycling infrastructure (cycle lanes, paths, and signage) on your typical route?
en.#Very inadequate — little or no cycling: Very inadequate — little or no cycling infrastructure exists
en.#Inadequate — some provision exists but: Inadequate — some provision exists but it is fragmented or poorly designed
en.#Partially adequate — infrastructure cov: Partially adequate — infrastructure covers part of my route
en.#Mostly adequate — infrastructure is rea: Mostly adequate — infrastructure is reasonably good along most of my route
en.#Very adequate — cycling infrastructure: Very adequate — cycling infrastructure is excellent throughout my route

it.#How adequate is the cycling infrastruct: Quanto è adeguata l’infrastruttura ciclabile, comprese piste, percorsi e segnaletica, lungo il tuo tragitto abituale?
it.#Very inadequate — little or no cycling: Del tutto inadeguata — l’infrastruttura ciclabile è scarsa o assente
it.#Inadequate — some provision exists but: Inadeguata — esistono alcune infrastrutture, ma sono frammentate o mal progettate
it.#Partially adequate — infrastructure cov: Parzialmente adeguata — l’infrastruttura copre solo una parte del mio percorso
it.#Mostly adequate — infrastructure is rea: Per lo più adeguata — l’infrastruttura è abbastanza buona lungo gran parte del mio percorso
it.#Very adequate — cycling infrastructure: Molto adeguata — l’infrastruttura ciclabile è eccellente lungo tutto il mio percorso

fr.#How adequate is the cycling infrastruct: Les infrastructures cyclables de votre trajet habituel, comme les pistes, les voies et la signalisation, sont-elles adaptées ?
fr.#Very inadequate — little or no cycling: Très insuffisantes — il y a peu ou pas d’infrastructures cyclables
fr.#Inadequate — some provision exists but: Insuffisantes — certaines infrastructures existent, mais elles sont discontinues ou mal conçues
fr.#Partially adequate — infrastructure cov: Partiellement adaptées — les infrastructures couvrent une partie de mon trajet
fr.#Mostly adequate — infrastructure is rea: Plutôt adaptées — les infrastructures sont assez bonnes sur la majeure partie de mon trajet
fr.#Very adequate — cycling infrastructure: Très adaptées — les infrastructures cyclables sont excellentes sur tout mon trajet

de.#How adequate is the cycling infrastruct: Wie gut ist die Fahrradinfrastruktur auf Ihrer üblichen Strecke, zum Beispiel Radwege, Fahrstreifen und Beschilderung?
de.#Very inadequate — little or no cycling: Sehr schlecht — es gibt kaum oder keine Fahrradinfrastruktur
de.#Inadequate — some provision exists but: Schlecht — es gibt zwar Infrastruktur, aber sie ist lückenhaft oder schlecht gestaltet
de.#Partially adequate — infrastructure cov: Teilweise gut — die Infrastruktur deckt einen Teil meiner Strecke ab
de.#Mostly adequate — infrastructure is rea: Meist gut — auf dem größten Teil meiner Strecke ist die Infrastruktur in Ordnung
de.#Very adequate — cycling infrastructure: Sehr gut — auf meiner gesamten Strecke ist die Fahrradinfrastruktur sehr gut

tr.#How adequate is the cycling infrastruct: Tipik güzergâhınızdaki bisiklet altyapısı, örneğin bisiklet yolları, şeritler ve yönlendirme işaretleri, ne kadar yeterli?
tr.#Very inadequate — little or no cycling: Çok yetersiz — çok az bisiklet altyapısı var veya hiç yok
tr.#Inadequate — some provision exists but: Yetersiz — bazı altyapılar var, ancak kesintili veya kötü tasarlanmış
tr.#Partially adequate — infrastructure cov: Kısmen yeterli — altyapı güzergâhımın bir bölümünü kapsıyor
tr.#Mostly adequate — infrastructure is rea: Büyük ölçüde yeterli — güzergâhımın çoğunda altyapı oldukça iyi
tr.#Very adequate — cycling infrastructure: Çok yeterli — güzergâhım boyunca bisiklet altyapısı çok iyi

fa.#How adequate is the cycling infrastruct: زیرساخت دوچرخه در مسیر معمول شما، مانند مسیر دوچرخه، خط دوچرخه و تابلوها، چقدر مناسب است؟
fa.#Very inadequate — little or no cycling: بسیار نامناسب — زیرساخت دوچرخه بسیار کم است یا وجود ندارد
fa.#Inadequate — some provision exists but: نامناسب — مقداری زیرساخت وجود دارد، اما پیوسته نیست یا طراحی خوبی ندارد

Moderately — I rely on signs to confirm my route

schema.text: How physically active are you in a typical week? Consider walking for transport, cycling, or dedicated exercise. If you have a condition affecting your mobility, select the level that best applies to you.

en.#How physically active are you in a typi: How physically active are you in a typical week? Consider walking for transport, cycling, or dedicated exercise. If you have a condition affecting your mobility, select the level that best applies to you.

it.#How physically active are you in a typi: Quanto sei fisicamente attivo/a durante una settimana tipica? Considera gli spostamenti a piedi, in bicicletta o l’attività fisica dedicata. Se hai una condizione che influisce sulla mobilità, seleziona il livello che descrive meglio la tua situazione.

fr.#How physically active are you in a typi: Pendant une semaine habituelle, quel est votre niveau d’activité physique ? Pensez à la marche pour vos déplacements, au vélo ou à une activité physique dédiée. Si vous avez une condition qui limite votre mobilité, choisissez le niveau qui vous correspond le mieux.
fr.#Daily / Near Daily (6–7 days): Tous les jours ou presque (6 à 7 jours)

de.#How physically active are you in a typi: Wie körperlich aktiv sind Sie in einer typischen Woche? Denken Sie an Wege zu Fuß, Radfahren oder gezielte Bewegung. Wenn Sie eine Einschränkung Ihrer Mobilität haben, wählen Sie bitte die Stufe, die am besten zu Ihnen passt.

tr.#How physically active are you in a typi: Tipik bir haftada ne kadar fiziksel olarak aktifsiniz? Ulaşım için yürümeyi, bisiklete binmeyi veya düzenli egzersizi düşünün. Hareketliliğinizi etkileyen bir durumunuz varsa, size en uygun düzeyi seçin.
tr.#Daily / Near Daily (6–7 days): Her gün veya neredeyse her gün (6-7 gün)

fa.#How physically active are you in a typi: در یک هفته معمولی چقدر فعالیت بدنی دارید؟ پیاده‌روی برای رفت‌وآمد، دوچرخه‌سواری یا ورزش را در نظر بگیرید. اگر شرایطی دارید که حرکت شما را محدود می‌کند، گزینه‌ای را انتخاب کنید که بیشتر با وضعیت شما سازگار است.
fa.#Daily / Near Daily (6–7 days): هر روز یا تقریباً هر روز (۶ تا ۷ روز)

hu.#How physically active are you in a typi: Mennyire fizikailag aktív egy átlagos héten? Gondoljon a közlekedési célú gyaloglásra, kerékpározásra vagy célzott testmozgásra. Ha mozgását valamilyen állapot befolyásolja, válassza az Önre leginkább jellemző szintet.

ar.#How physically active are you in a typi: ما مدى نشاطك البدني في أسبوع عادي؟ فكر في المشي للتنقل، وركوب الدراجة، أو التمارين الرياضية. إذا كانت لديك حالة تؤثر في حركتك، اختر المستوى الذي يناسب حالتك أكثر.

schema.text: In a typical week, on how many days do you walk, cycle or do physical activity for at least 30 minutes in total? If you have a condition affecting your mobility, count the activity you are able to do.

en.#In a typical week, on how many days do: In a typical week, on how many days do you walk, cycle or do physical activity for at least 30 minutes in total? If you have a condition affecting your mobility, count the activity you are able to do.

it.#In a typical week, on how many days do: In una settimana tipica, in quanti giorni cammini, vai in bicicletta o fai attività fisica per almeno 30 minuti in tutto? Se hai una condizione che influisce sulla mobilità, conta l’attività che riesci a fare.

fr.#In a typical week, on how many days do: Au cours d’une semaine type, combien de jours marchez-vous, faites-vous du vélo ou une activité physique pendant au moins 30 minutes au total ? Si vous avez un problème qui affecte votre mobilité, comptez l’activité que vous êtes en mesure de faire.
fr.#6-7 days (every day or almost): 6 à 7 jours (tous les jours ou presque)

de.#In a typical week, on how many days do: An wie vielen Tagen einer typischen Woche gehen Sie zu Fuß, fahren Rad oder sind insgesamt mindestens 30 Minuten körperlich aktiv? Wenn Sie eine Beeinträchtigung Ihrer Mobilität haben, zählen Sie die Aktivität, die Ihnen möglich ist.

tr.#In a typical week, on how many days do: Tipik bir haftada kaç gün toplamda en az 30 dakika yürüyor, bisiklete biniyor veya fiziksel aktivite yapıyorsunuz? Hareketliliğinizi etkileyen bir durumunuz varsa, yapabildiğiniz aktiviteyi sayın.
tr.#6-7 days (every day or almost): 6-7 gün (her gün veya neredeyse her gün)

fa.#In a typical week, on how many days do: در یک هفته معمول، چند روز در مجموع دست‌کم ۳۰ دقیقه پیاده‌روی، دوچرخه‌سواری یا فعالیت بدنی دارید؟ اگر وضعیتی دارید که بر تحرک شما اثر می‌گذارد، فعالیتی را که می‌توانید انجام دهید بشمارید.
fa.#6-7 days (every day or almost): ۶ تا ۷ روز (هر روز یا تقریباً هر روز)

hu.#In a typical week, on how many days do: Egy átlagos héten hány napon gyalogol, kerékpározik vagy végez testmozgást összesen legalább 30 percig? Ha valamilyen állapot befolyásolja a mozgását, azt a tevékenységet számolja, amelyre képes.
hu.#6-7 days (every day or almost): 6-7 nap (minden nap vagy majdnem minden nap)

ar.#In a typical week, on how many days do: في أسبوع عادي، كم يومًا تمشي أو تركب الدراجة أو تمارس نشاطًا بدنيًا لمدة 30 دقيقة على الأقل في المجموع؟ إذا كانت لديك حالة تؤثر في قدرتك على الحركة، فاحسب النشاط الذي تستطيع القيام به.

fr.#How does the availability of benches an: Comment la présence de bancs et de zones de repos influence-t-elle votre capacité à terminer votre trajet ?
fr.#Seating has no influence on my travel c: Les bancs n’influencent ni mes choix de déplacement ni mon endurance
fr.#I notice the lack of seating makes the: Je remarque le manque de bancs, ce qui rend le trajet moins confortable, mais je peux quand même le terminer
fr.#I do not plan my trip around them but I: Je ne choisis pas mon itinéraire en fonction des bancs, mais je les utilise si je suis fatigué(e) ou si je porte des objets lourds
fr.#I specifically choose routes with seati: Je choisis certains itinéraires parce qu’ils ont des bancs où je peux faire une pause, même s’ils sont moins directs
fr.#I rely on rest areas to make my journey: J’ai besoin de zones de repos pour pouvoir faire ce trajet ; sans elles, je ne pourrais pas aller aussi loin

de.#How does the availability of benches an: Wie beeinflussen Bänke und Ruheplätze Ihre Möglichkeit, Ihren Weg zu Ende zu gehen?
de.#Seating has no influence on my travel c: Sitzmöglichkeiten beeinflussen weder meine Verkehrsmittelwahl noch meine Ausdauer
de.#I notice the lack of seating makes the: Fehlende Sitzmöglichkeiten machen den Weg weniger angenehm, aber ich kann ihn trotzdem zu Ende gehen
de.#I do not plan my trip around them but I: Ich plane meine Route nicht nach Sitzmöglichkeiten, nutze sie aber, wenn ich unerwartet müde bin oder schwere Dinge trage
de.#I specifically choose routes with seati: Ich wähle gezielt Wege mit Sitzmöglichkeiten für Pausen, auch wenn sie nicht die direkteste Route sind
de.#I rely on rest areas to make my journey: Ich brauche Ruheplätze, um diesen Weg schaffen zu können; ohne sie könnte ich nicht so weit gehen

tr.#How does the availability of benches an: Bankların ve dinlenme alanlarının bulunması yolculuğunuzu tamamlayabilmenizi nasıl etkiler?
tr.#Seating has no influence on my travel c: Oturma alanları ulaşım tercihlerimi veya fiziksel dayanıklılığımı etkilemez
tr.#I notice the lack of seating makes the: Oturma alanlarının azlığını fark ederim; yolculuk daha az rahat olur ama tamamlamama engel olmaz
tr.#I do not plan my trip around them but I: Yolculuğumu banklara göre planlamam ama beklenmedik şekilde yorulursam veya ağır bir şey taşıyorsam kullanırım
tr.#I specifically choose routes with seati: Dinlenebilmek için özellikle oturma alanı olan güzergâhları seçerim, daha uzun olsalar bile

fa.#How does the availability of benches an: وجود نیمکت و محل استراحت چه اثری بر توانایی شما برای کامل کردن سفر دارد؟
fa.#Seating has no influence on my travel c: محل نشستن بر انتخاب سفر یا توان جسمی من اثری ندارد
fa.#I notice the lack of seating makes the: کمبود محل نشستن سفر را کمتر راحت می‌کند، اما مانع تمام کردن آن نمی‌شود
fa.#I do not plan my trip around them but I: مسیرم را بر اساس نیمکت انتخاب نمی‌کنم، اما اگر ناگهان خسته شوم یا بار سنگین داشته باشم از آن استفاده می‌کنم
fa.#I specifically choose routes with seati: برای اینکه بتوانم استراحت کنم، مسیرهایی را انتخاب می‌کنم که محل نشستن دارند، حتی اگر مستقیم‌ترین راه نباشند
fa.#I rely on rest areas to make my journey: برای اینکه بتوانم این مسافت را طی کنم به محل استراحت نیاز دارم؛ بدون آن نمی‌توانم تا این فاصله بروم

hu.#How does the availability of benches an: Hogyan befolyásolja a padok és pihenőhelyek elérhetősége azt, hogy végig tudja-e járni az útját?
hu.#Seating has no influence on my travel c: Az ülőhelyek nem befolyásolják sem a közlekedési döntéseimet, sem a fizikai állóképességemet
hu.#I notice the lack of seating makes the: Észreveszem az ülőhelyek hiányát, és emiatt kevésbé kényelmes az út, de be tudom fejezni
hu.#I do not plan my trip around them but I: Nem az ülőhelyek alapján tervezem az utat, de használom őket, ha váratlanul elfáradok vagy nehéz dolgot viszek
hu.#I specifically choose routes with seati: Kifejezetten olyan útvonalat választok, ahol le tudok ülni pihenni, még akkor is, ha az nem a legrövidebb
hu.#I rely on rest areas to make my journey: Szükségem van pihenőhelyekre ahhoz, hogy ezt a távolságot meg tudjam tenni; nélkülük nem jutnék ilyen messzire

ar.#How does the availability of benches an: كيف يؤثر توفر المقاعد وأماكن الراحة في قدرتك على إكمال رحلتك؟
ar.#Seating has no influence on my travel c: المقاعد لا تؤثر في اختياراتي أو قدرتي البدنية
ar.#I notice the lack of seating makes the: ألاحظ نقص المقاعد ويجعل الرحلة أقل راحة، لكنه لا يمنعني من إكمالها
ar.#I do not plan my trip around them but I: لا أخطط طريقي بناءً على وجود المقاعد، لكنني أستخدمها إذا تعبت فجأة أو كنت أحمل أشياء ثقيلة
ar.#I specifically choose routes with seati: أختار عمدًا طرقًا فيها مقاعد حتى أستطيع الاستراحة، حتى لو لم تكن أقصر طريق
ar.#I rely on rest areas to make my journey: أعتمد على أماكن الراحة لأتمكن من إكمال الرحلة؛ من دونها لا أستطيع المشي لهذه المسافة

options.text: Yes, with a dedicated bicycle space
Yes, but people cycling probably need to dismount
No, it is not possible to get through by bicycle

it.#Can people cycle through this place?: Si può passare in bicicletta in questo luogo?

it.#Yes, shared with people walking: Sì, condiviso con persone a piedi

schema.text: To what extent does the steepness of your route affect your cycling?

options.text: Slightly — I notice hills but they do not significantly affect my journey
Moderately — hills slow me down or increase my effort noticeably
Significantly — I avoid steep routes when possible
Extremely — hills are a major barrier that limits where I can cycle

en.#To what extent does the steepness of yo: To what extent does the steepness of your route affect your cycling?
en.#Slightly — I notice hills but they do n: Slightly — I notice hills but they do not significantly affect my journey
en.#Moderately — hills slow me down or incr: Moderately — hills slow me down or increase my effort noticeably
en.#Significantly — I avoid steep routes wh: Significantly — I avoid steep routes when possible
en.#Extremely — hills are a major barrier t: Extremely — hills are a major barrier that limits where I can cycle

it.#To what extent does the steepness of yo: In che misura la pendenza del percorso influisce sui tuoi spostamenti in bicicletta?
it.#Slightly — I notice hills but they do n: Poco — noto le salite, ma non influenzano significativamente il mio viaggio
it.#Moderately — hills slow me down or incr: Moderatamente — le salite mi rallentano o aumentano sensibilmente lo sforzo
it.#Significantly — I avoid steep routes wh: Molto — evito i percorsi ripidi quando possibile
it.#Extremely — hills are a major barrier t: Moltissimo — le salite rappresentano un ostacolo importante che limita i luoghi in cui posso andare in bicicletta

fr.#To what extent does the steepness of yo: Dans quelle mesure la pente de votre itinéraire influence-t-elle vos déplacements à vélo ?
fr.#Slightly — I notice hills but they do n: Un peu — je remarque les montées, mais elles ne changent pas vraiment mon trajet
fr.#Moderately — hills slow me down or incr: Modérément — les montées me ralentissent ou augmentent nettement mon effort
fr.#Significantly — I avoid steep routes wh: Beaucoup — j’évite les itinéraires très pentus quand c’est possible
fr.#Extremely — hills are a major barrier t: Énormément — les montées sont un obstacle important qui limite mes déplacements à vélo

de.#To what extent does the steepness of yo: Wie stark beeinflusst die Steigung Ihrer Strecke Ihr Radfahren?
de.#Slightly — I notice hills but they do n: Etwas — ich merke Steigungen, aber sie beeinflussen meine Fahrt kaum
de.#Moderately — hills slow me down or incr: Mäßig — Steigungen verlangsamen mich oder machen die Fahrt deutlich anstrengender
de.#Significantly — I avoid steep routes wh: Stark — ich vermeide steile Strecken, wenn es möglich ist
de.#Extremely — hills are a major barrier t: Sehr stark — Steigungen sind ein großes Hindernis und schränken ein, wo ich Rad fahren kann

tr.#To what extent does the steepness of yo: Güzergâhınızdaki eğim bisiklet kullanımınızı ne ölçüde etkiler?
tr.#Slightly — I notice hills but they do n: Biraz — yokuşları fark ederim ama yolculuğumu çok etkilemez
tr.#Moderately — hills slow me down or incr: Orta düzeyde — yokuşlar beni yavaşlatır veya harcadığım çabayı belirgin şekilde artırır
tr.#Significantly — I avoid steep routes wh: Çok — mümkün olduğunda dik güzergâhlardan kaçınırım
tr.#Extremely — hills are a major barrier t: Çok fazla — yokuşlar bisikletle gidebildiğim yerleri önemli ölçüde sınırlar

fa.#To what extent does the steepness of yo: شیب مسیر تا چه اندازه بر دوچرخه‌سواری شما اثر دارد؟
fa.#Slightly — I notice hills but they do n: کمی — سربالایی را حس می‌کنم، اما تأثیر زیادی بر سفرم ندارد
fa.#Moderately — hills slow me down or incr: تا حد متوسط — سربالایی سرعت مرا کم می‌کند یا تلاش بیشتری می‌طلبد
fa.#Significantly — I avoid steep routes wh: زیاد — اگر ممکن باشد از مسیرهای پرشیب دوری می‌کنم
fa.#Extremely — hills are a major barrier t: خیلی زیاد — سربالایی مانع بزرگی است و محدوده دوچرخه‌سواری مرا کم می‌کند

hu.#To what extent does the steepness of yo: Mennyire befolyásolja az útvonal emelkedése a kerékpározását?
hu.#Slightly — I notice hills but they do n: Kissé — érzékelem az emelkedőket, de nem befolyásolják jelentősen az utamat
hu.#Moderately — hills slow me down or incr: Közepesen — az emelkedők lelassítanak vagy érezhetően növelik a fizikai erőfeszítést
hu.#Significantly — I avoid steep routes wh: Jelentősen — amikor lehet, kerülöm a meredek útvonalakat
hu.#Extremely — hills are a major barrier t: Nagyon erősen — az emelkedők komoly akadályt jelentenek és korlátozzák, hol tudok kerékpározni

ar.#To what extent does the steepness of yo: إلى أي مدى يؤثر انحدار الطريق في ركوبك للدراجة؟
ar.#Slightly — I notice hills but they do n: قليلًا — ألاحظ المرتفعات لكنها لا تؤثر كثيرًا في الرحلة
ar.#Moderately — hills slow me down or incr: بدرجة متوسطة — المرتفعات تبطئني أو تزيد الجهد بشكل واضح
ar.#Significantly — I avoid steep routes wh: بدرجة كبيرة — أتجنب الطرق شديدة الانحدار عندما يكون ذلك ممكنًا
ar.#Extremely — hills are a major barrier t: بدرجة كبيرة جدًا — المرتفعات عائق رئيسي يحد من الأماكن التي أستطيع الوصول إليها بالدراجة

schema.text: How confident are you in your ability to anticipate and react to dangerous situations while cycling (e.g., car doors opening suddenly, vehicles cutting across, or blind junctions)?

options.text: Not confident at all — I feel unprepared for these situations
Slightly confident — I am aware of the risks but often feel caught off guard
Moderately confident — I manage most situations but some still worry me
Quite confident — I anticipate most hazards and respond well
Very confident — I feel well prepared for all typical cycling hazards

en.#How confident are you in your ability t: How confident are you in your ability to anticipate and react to dangerous situations while cycling (e.g., car doors opening suddenly, vehicles cutting across, or blind junctions)?
en.#Not confident at all — I feel unprepare: Not confident at all — I feel unprepared for these situations
en.#Slightly confident — I am aware of the: Slightly confident — I am aware of the risks but often feel caught off guard
en.#Moderately confident — I manage most si: Moderately confident — I manage most situations but some still worry me
en.#Quite confident — I anticipate most haz: Quite confident — I anticipate most hazards and respond well
en.#Very confident — I feel well prepared f: Very confident — I feel well prepared for all typical cycling hazards

it.#How confident are you in your ability t: Quanto ti senti sicuro/a della tua capacità di prevedere e affrontare situazioni pericolose mentre pedali, ad esempio porte di auto che si aprono improvvisamente, veicoli che tagliano la strada o incroci con scarsa visibilità?
it.#Not confident at all — I feel unprepare: Per niente sicuro/a — mi sento impreparato/a ad affrontare queste situazioni
it.#Slightly confident — I am aware of the: Poco sicuro/a — sono consapevole dei rischi, ma spesso vengo colto/a di sorpresa
it.#Moderately confident — I manage most si: Moderatamente sicuro/a — gestisco la maggior parte delle situazioni, ma alcune mi preoccupano ancora
it.#Quite confident — I anticipate most haz: Abbastanza sicuro/a — prevedo la maggior parte dei pericoli e reagisco bene
it.#Very confident — I feel well prepared f: Molto sicuro/a — mi sento ben preparato/a ad affrontare i pericoli tipici della mobilità ciclistica

fr.#How confident are you in your ability t: À quel point vous sentez-vous capable d’anticiper et de réagir aux situations dangereuses à vélo, par exemple une portière qui s’ouvre soudainement, un véhicule qui coupe votre trajectoire ou un carrefour avec mauvaise visibilité ?
fr.#Not confident at all — I feel unprepare: Pas du tout en confiance — je ne me sens pas préparé(e) à ces situations
fr.#Slightly confident — I am aware of the: Un peu en confiance — je connais les risques, mais je suis souvent surpris(e)
fr.#Moderately confident — I manage most si: Modérément en confiance — je gère la plupart des situations, mais certaines m’inquiètent encore
fr.#Quite confident — I anticipate most haz: Plutôt en confiance — j’anticipe la plupart des dangers et je réagis correctement
fr.#Very confident — I feel well prepared f: Très en confiance — je me sens bien préparé(e) aux dangers habituels à vélo

de.#How confident are you in your ability t: Wie sicher fühlen Sie sich darin, gefährliche Situationen beim Radfahren früh zu erkennen und darauf zu reagieren, zum Beispiel plötzlich geöffnete Autotüren, abbiegende Fahrzeuge oder unübersichtliche Kreuzungen?
de.#Not confident at all — I feel unprepare: Gar nicht sicher — ich fühle mich auf solche Situationen nicht vorbereitet
de.#Slightly confident — I am aware of the: Etwas sicher — ich kenne die Risiken, werde aber oft überrascht
de.#Moderately confident — I manage most si: Mäßig sicher — ich komme mit den meisten Situationen zurecht, manche machen mir aber noch Sorgen
de.#Quite confident — I anticipate most haz: Ziemlich sicher — ich erkenne die meisten Gefahren früh und reagiere gut
de.#Very confident — I feel well prepared f: Sehr sicher — ich fühle mich auf die typischen Gefahren beim Radfahren gut vorbereitet

tr.#How confident are you in your ability t: Bisiklet sürerken tehlikeli durumları önceden fark edip tepki verme konusunda kendinizi ne kadar güvende hissediyorsunuz? Örneğin aniden açılan otomobil kapıları, önünüzü kesen araçlar veya görüşü kısıtlı kavşaklar.
tr.#Not confident at all — I feel unprepare: Hiç güvende hissetmiyorum — bu durumlara hazırlıklı hissetmiyorum
tr.#Slightly confident — I am aware of the: Biraz güvende hissediyorum — riskleri biliyorum ama sık sık hazırlıksız yakalanıyorum
tr.#Moderately confident — I manage most si: Orta düzeyde güvende hissediyorum — çoğu durumla başa çıkıyorum ama bazıları hâlâ beni endişelendiriyor
tr.#Quite confident — I anticipate most haz: Oldukça güvende hissediyorum — çoğu tehlikeyi önceden fark edip uygun şekilde tepki veriyorum
tr.#Very confident — I feel well prepared f: Çok güvende hissediyorum — bisiklet kullanırken karşılaşılabilecek tipik tehlikelere iyi hazırlandığımı düşünüyorum

fa.#How confident are you in your ability t: در پیش‌بینی و واکنش به موقعیت‌های خطرناک هنگام دوچرخه‌سواری چقدر به توانایی خود اطمینان دارید؟ مثلاً باز شدن ناگهانی در خودرو، پیچیدن خودرو جلوی شما یا تقاطع با دید محدود.
fa.#Not confident at all — I feel unprepare: اصلاً مطمئن نیستم — برای این موقعیت‌ها آماده نیستم
fa.#Slightly confident — I am aware of the: کمی مطمئنم — خطرها را می‌شناسم اما اغلب غافلگیر می‌شوم
fa.#Moderately confident — I manage most si: تا حد متوسط مطمئنم — بیشتر موقعیت‌ها را مدیریت می‌کنم، اما بعضی هنوز نگرانم می‌کنند
fa.#Quite confident — I anticipate most haz: نسبتاً مطمئنم — بیشتر خطرها را از قبل تشخیص می‌دهم و خوب واکنش نشان می‌دهم
fa.#Very confident — I feel well prepared f: خیلی مطمئنم — برای خطرهای معمول دوچرخه‌سواری آمادگی خوبی دارم

hu.#How confident are you in your ability t: Mennyire érzi magát magabiztosnak abban, hogy előre felismeri és kezeli a veszélyes helyzeteket kerékpározás közben, például hirtelen kinyíló autóajtót, elé forduló járművet vagy beláthatatlan kereszteződést?
hu.#Not confident at all — I feel unprepare: Egyáltalán nem vagyok magabiztos — nem érzem magam felkészültnek ezekre a helyzetekre
hu.#Slightly confident — I am aware of the: Kissé magabiztos vagyok — ismerem a kockázatokat, de gyakran váratlanul érnek
hu.#Moderately confident — I manage most si: Közepesen magabiztos vagyok — a legtöbb helyzetet kezelem, de néhány még aggaszt
hu.#Quite confident — I anticipate most haz: Elég magabiztos vagyok — a legtöbb veszélyt előre észreveszem és megfelelően reagálok
hu.#Very confident — I feel well prepared f: Nagyon magabiztos vagyok — jól felkészültnek érzem magam a kerékpározás tipikus veszélyeire

ar.#How confident are you in your ability t: ما مدى ثقتك في قدرتك على توقع المواقف الخطرة والتعامل معها أثناء ركوب الدراجة، مثل فتح باب سيارة فجأة أو قطع مركبة لطريقك أو تقاطع محدود الرؤية؟
ar.#Not confident at all — I feel unprepare: لست واثقًا إطلاقًا — لا أشعر أنني مستعد لهذه المواقف
ar.#Slightly confident — I am aware of the: واثق قليلًا — أعرف المخاطر لكنني أفاجأ بها كثيرًا
ar.#Moderately confident — I manage most si: واثق بدرجة متوسطة — أتعامل مع معظم المواقف لكن بعضها ما زال يقلقني
ar.#Quite confident — I anticipate most haz: واثق إلى حد كبير — أتوقع معظم المخاطر وأستجيب جيدًا
ar.#Very confident — I feel well prepared f: واثق جدًا — أشعر أنني مستعد جيدًا للمخاطر المعتادة عند ركوب الدراجة

en.#How confident are you in your ability t: How confident are you in your ability to anticipate and react to dangerous situations while cycling (e.g., car doors opening suddenly, vehicles cutting across, or blind junctions)?
en.#Not confident at all — I feel unprepare: Not confident at all — I feel unprepared for these situations
en.#Slightly confident — I am aware of the: Slightly confident — I am aware of the risks but often feel caught off guard
en.#Moderately confident — I manage most si: Moderately confident — I manage most situations but some still worry me
en.#Quite confident — I anticipate most haz: Quite confident — I anticipate most hazards and respond well
en.#Very confident — I feel well prepared f: Very confident — I feel well prepared for all typical cycling hazards

it.#How confident are you in your ability t: Quanto ti senti sicuro/a della tua capacità di prevedere e affrontare situazioni pericolose mentre pedali, ad esempio porte di auto che si aprono improvvisamente, veicoli che tagliano la strada o incroci con scarsa visibilità?
it.#Not confident at all — I feel unprepare: Per niente sicuro/a — mi sento impreparato/a ad affrontare queste situazioni
it.#Slightly confident — I am aware of the: Poco sicuro/a — sono consapevole dei rischi, ma spesso vengo colto/a di sorpresa
it.#Moderately confident — I manage most si: Moderatamente sicuro/a — gestisco la maggior parte delle situazioni, ma alcune mi preoccupano ancora
it.#Quite confident — I anticipate most haz: Abbastanza sicuro/a — prevedo la maggior parte dei pericoli e reagisco bene
it.#Very confident — I feel well prepared f: Molto sicuro/a — mi sento ben preparato/a ad affrontare i pericoli tipici della mobilità ciclistica

fr.#How confident are you in your ability t: À quel point vous sentez-vous capable d’anticiper et de réagir aux situations dangereuses à vélo, par exemple une portière qui s’ouvre soudainement, un véhicule qui coupe votre trajectoire ou un carrefour avec mauvaise visibilité ?
fr.#Not confident at all — I feel unprepare: Pas du tout en confiance — je ne me sens pas préparé(e) à ces situations
fr.#Slightly confident — I am aware of the: Un peu en confiance — je connais les risques, mais je suis souvent surpris(e)
fr.#Moderately confident — I manage most si: Modérément en confiance — je gère la plupart des situations, mais certaines m’inquiètent encore
fr.#Quite confident — I anticipate most haz: Plutôt en confiance — j’anticipe la plupart des dangers et je réagis correctement
fr.#Very confident — I feel well prepared f: Très en confiance — je me sens bien préparé(e) aux dangers habituels à vélo

de.#How confident are you in your ability t: Wie sicher fühlen Sie sich darin, gefährliche Situationen beim Radfahren früh zu erkennen und darauf zu reagieren, zum Beispiel plötzlich geöffnete Autotüren, abbiegende Fahrzeuge oder unübersichtliche Kreuzungen?
de.#Not confident at all — I feel unprepare: Gar nicht sicher — ich fühle mich auf solche Situationen nicht vorbereitet
de.#Slightly confident — I am aware of the: Etwas sicher — ich kenne die Risiken, werde aber oft überrascht
de.#Moderately confident — I manage most si: Mäßig sicher — ich komme mit den meisten Situationen zurecht, manche machen mir aber noch Sorgen
de.#Quite confident — I anticipate most haz: Ziemlich sicher — ich erkenne die meisten Gefahren früh und reagiere gut
de.#Very confident — I feel well prepared f: Sehr sicher — ich fühle mich auf die typischen Gefahren beim Radfahren gut vorbereitet

tr.#How confident are you in your ability t: Bisiklet sürerken tehlikeli durumları önceden fark edip tepki verme konusunda kendinizi ne kadar güvende hissediyorsunuz? Örneğin aniden açılan otomobil kapıları, önünüzü kesen araçlar veya görüşü kısıtlı kavşaklar.
tr.#Not confident at all — I feel unprepare: Hiç güvende hissetmiyorum — bu durumlara hazırlıklı hissetmiyorum
tr.#Slightly confident — I am aware of the: Biraz güvende hissediyorum — riskleri biliyorum ama sık sık hazırlıksız yakalanıyorum
tr.#Moderately confident — I manage most si: Orta düzeyde güvende hissediyorum — çoğu durumla başa çıkıyorum ama bazıları hâlâ beni endişelendiriyor
tr.#Quite confident — I anticipate most haz: Oldukça güvende hissediyorum — çoğu tehlikeyi önceden fark edip uygun şekilde tepki veriyorum
tr.#Very confident — I feel well prepared f: Çok güvende hissediyorum — bisiklet kullanırken karşılaşılabilecek tipik tehlikelere iyi hazırlandığımı düşünüyorum

fa.#How confident are you in your ability t: در پیش‌بینی و واکنش به موقعیت‌های خطرناک هنگام دوچرخه‌سواری چقدر به توانایی خود اطمینان دارید؟ مثلاً باز شدن ناگهانی در خودرو، پیچیدن خودرو جلوی شما یا تقاطع با دید محدود.
fa.#Not confident at all — I feel unprepare: اصلاً مطمئن نیستم — برای این موقعیت‌ها آماده نیستم
fa.#Slightly confident — I am aware of the: کمی مطمئنم — خطرها را می‌شناسم اما اغلب غافلگیر می‌شوم
fa.#Moderately confident — I manage most si: تا حد متوسط مطمئنم — بیشتر موقعیت‌ها را مدیریت می‌کنم، اما بعضی هنوز نگرانم می‌کنند
fa.#Quite confident — I anticipate most haz: نسبتاً مطمئنم — بیشتر خطرها را از قبل تشخیص می‌دهم و خوب واکنش نشان می‌دهم
fa.#Very confident — I feel well prepared f: خیلی مطمئنم — برای خطرهای معمول دوچرخه‌سواری آمادگی خوبی دارم

hu.#How confident are you in your ability t: Mennyire érzi magát magabiztosnak abban, hogy előre felismeri és kezeli a veszélyes helyzeteket kerékpározás közben, például hirtelen kinyíló autóajtót, elé forduló járművet vagy beláthatatlan kereszteződést?
hu.#Not confident at all — I feel unprepare: Egyáltalán nem vagyok magabiztos — nem érzem magam felkészültnek ezekre a helyzetekre
hu.#Slightly confident — I am aware of the: Kissé magabiztos vagyok — ismerem a kockázatokat, de gyakran váratlanul érnek
hu.#Moderately confident — I manage most si: Közepesen magabiztos vagyok — a legtöbb helyzetet kezelem, de néhány még aggaszt
hu.#Quite confident — I anticipate most haz: Elég magabiztos vagyok — a legtöbb veszélyt előre észreveszem és megfelelően reagálok
hu.#Very confident — I feel well prepared f: Nagyon magabiztos vagyok — jól felkészültnek érzem magam a kerékpározás tipikus veszélyeire

ar.#How confident are you in your ability t: ما مدى ثقتك في قدرتك على توقع المواقف الخطرة والتعامل معها أثناء ركوب الدراجة، مثل فتح باب سيارة فجأة أو قطع مركبة لطريقك أو تقاطع محدود الرؤية؟
ar.#Not confident at all — I feel unprepare: لست واثقًا إطلاقًا — لا أشعر أنني مستعد لهذه المواقف
ar.#Slightly confident — I am aware of the: واثق قليلًا — أعرف المخاطر لكنني أفاجأ بها كثيرًا
ar.#Moderately confident — I manage most si: واثق بدرجة متوسطة — أتعامل مع معظم المواقف لكن بعضها ما زال يقلقني
ar.#Quite confident — I anticipate most haz: واثق إلى حد كبير — أتوقع معظم المخاطر وأستجيب جيدًا
ar.#Very confident — I feel well prepared f: واثق جدًا — أشعر أنني مستعد جيدًا للمخاطر المعتادة عند ركوب الدراجة

I notice it but continue without changing my behaviour
I slow down or adjust my line but stay on the same route
I actively avoid roads with poor surfaces, even if the alternative is longer
Poor surfaces significantly limit where and how often I can cycle

it.#To what extent do emissions concerns in: In che misura le preoccupazioni relative alle emissioni influenzano le tue scelte di viaggio?

fr.#To what extent do emissions concerns in: Dans quelle mesure les émissions polluantes influencent-elles vos choix de déplacement ?
fr.#Not at all, emissions concerns do not i: Pas du tout : les émissions n’influencent pas mes choix de déplacement
fr.#Slightly, I occasionally think about em: Un peu : je pense parfois aux émissions quand je choisis comment me déplacer
fr.#Moderately, emissions concerns sometime: Modérément : les émissions influencent parfois mes décisions de déplacement
fr.#Strongly, emissions concerns regularly: Beaucoup : les émissions influencent régulièrement ma façon de me déplacer
fr.#Very strongly, I actively try to reduce: Énormément : j’essaie activement de moins utiliser la voiture à cause des émissions

de.#To what extent do emissions concerns in: Wie stark beeinflussen Bedenken wegen Emissionen Ihre Verkehrsmittelwahl?
de.#Not at all, emissions concerns do not i: Gar nicht: Emissionen beeinflussen meine Wahl nicht
de.#Slightly, I occasionally think about em: Etwas: Ich denke gelegentlich an Emissionen, wenn ich entscheide, wie ich fahre
de.#Moderately, emissions concerns sometime: Mäßig: Emissionen beeinflussen manchmal meine Entscheidungen
de.#Strongly, emissions concerns regularly: Stark: Emissionen beeinflussen regelmäßig, wie ich mich fortbewege
de.#Very strongly, I actively try to reduce: Sehr stark: Wegen der Emissionen versuche ich aktiv, weniger Auto zu fahren

tr.#To what extent do emissions concerns in: Emisyonlarla ilgili kaygılar ulaşım tercihlerinizi ne ölçüde etkiler?

tr.#Slightly, I occasionally think about em: Biraz etkiler: nasıl gideceğime karar verirken bazen emisyonları düşünürüm
tr.#Moderately, emissions concerns sometime: Orta düzeyde etkiler: emisyon kaygıları bazen kararlarımı etkiler

tr.#Very strongly, I actively try to reduce: Çok güçlü etkiler: emisyonlar nedeniyle otomobil kullanımımı azaltmaya özellikle çalışırım

fa.#To what extent do emissions concerns in: نگرانی درباره آلایندگی تا چه اندازه بر انتخاب‌های سفر شما اثر می‌گذارد؟
fa.#Not at all, emissions concerns do not i: اصلاً؛ نگرانی درباره آلایندگی بر انتخاب من اثر ندارد
fa.#Slightly, I occasionally think about em: کمی؛ گاهی هنگام انتخاب روش سفر به آلایندگی فکر می‌کنم
fa.#Moderately, emissions concerns sometime: تا حد متوسط؛ نگرانی درباره آلایندگی گاهی بر تصمیم من اثر می‌گذارد
fa.#Strongly, emissions concerns regularly: زیاد؛ نگرانی درباره آلایندگی مرتب بر نحوه رفت‌وآمد من اثر می‌گذارد
fa.#Very strongly, I actively try to reduce: خیلی زیاد؛ به دلیل نگرانی درباره آلایندگی تلاش می‌کنم استفاده از خودرو را کاهش دهم

hu.#To what extent do emissions concerns in: Mennyire befolyásolják a károsanyag-kibocsátással kapcsolatos szempontok az utazási döntéseit?
hu.#Not at all, emissions concerns do not i: Egyáltalán nem: a kibocsátás nem befolyásolja az utazási döntéseimet
hu.#Slightly, I occasionally think about em: Kissé: néha gondolok a kibocsátásra, amikor eldöntöm, hogyan utazzak
hu.#Moderately, emissions concerns sometime: Közepesen: a kibocsátás néha befolyásolja a döntéseimet
hu.#Strongly, emissions concerns regularly: Erősen: a kibocsátás rendszeresen befolyásolja, hogyan közlekedem
hu.#Very strongly, I actively try to reduce: Nagyon erősen: a kibocsátás miatt tudatosan próbálom csökkenteni az autóhasználatot

ar.#To what extent do emissions concerns in: إلى أي مدى تؤثر مخاوف الانبعاثات في اختياراتك للتنقل؟
ar.#Not at all, emissions concerns do not i: لا تؤثر إطلاقًا؛ مخاوف الانبعاثات لا تغير اختياراتي
ar.#Slightly, I occasionally think about em: تؤثر قليلًا؛ أفكر أحيانًا في الانبعاثات عندما أقرر كيف أتنقل
ar.#Moderately, emissions concerns sometime: تؤثر بدرجة متوسطة؛ مخاوف الانبعاثات تؤثر أحيانًا في قراراتي
ar.#Strongly, emissions concerns regularly: تؤثر كثيرًا؛ مخاوف الانبعاثات تؤثر بانتظام في طريقة تنقلي
ar.#Very strongly, I actively try to reduce: تؤثر كثيرًا جدًا؛ أحاول بوعي تقليل استخدام السيارة بسبب الانبعاثات

schema.text: Compared to other travel options available to you (e.g., walking, driving, public transport), how would you rate the overall effort required by your usual mode of travel?

This is a bit easier than other ways I could travel
Regardless of the mode the effort feels roughly equal
This takes a bit more out of me than other options would
Far more demanding than alternatives (physically or mentally)

en.#Compared to other travel options availa: Compared to other travel options available to you (e.g., walking, driving, public transport), how would you rate the overall effort required by your usual mode of travel?
en.#My current mode is significantly easier: My current mode is significantly easier and more relaxing than any alternative
en.#This is a bit easier than other ways I: This is a bit easier than other ways I could travel
en.#Regardless of the mode the effort feels: Regardless of the mode the effort feels roughly equal
en.#This takes a bit more out of me than ot: This takes a bit more out of me than other options would
en.#Far more demanding than alternatives (p: Far more demanding than alternatives (physically or mentally)

it.#Compared to other travel options availa: Rispetto alle altre modalità di trasporto a tua disposizione (ad es. a piedi, in auto, con il trasporto pubblico), come valuteresti lo sforzo complessivo richiesto dalla modalità che utilizzi abitualmente?
it.#My current mode is significantly easier: La modalità che utilizzo attualmente è decisamente più facile e rilassante di qualsiasi alternativa
it.#This is a bit easier than other ways I: È un po' più facile rispetto alle altre modalità con cui potrei spostarmi
it.#Regardless of the mode the effort feels: Indipendentemente dalla modalità, lo sforzo mi sembra più o meno equivalente
it.#This takes a bit more out of me than ot: Questa modalità richiede un po' più di energie rispetto alle altre opzioni
it.#Far more demanding than alternatives (p: Molto più impegnativa delle alternative, dal punto di vista fisico o mentale

fr.#Compared to other travel options availa: Par rapport aux autres possibilités de déplacement dont vous disposez, par exemple la marche, la voiture ou les transports publics, comment évaluez-vous l’effort global demandé par votre mode de transport habituel ?
fr.#My current mode is significantly easier: Mon mode actuel est nettement plus facile et plus reposant que toutes les autres possibilités
fr.#This is a bit easier than other ways I: C’est un peu plus facile que les autres façons dont je pourrais me déplacer
fr.#Regardless of the mode the effort feels: Quel que soit le mode, l’effort me semble à peu près le même
fr.#This takes a bit more out of me than ot: Ce mode me demande un peu plus d’effort que les autres possibilités
fr.#Far more demanding than alternatives (p: Beaucoup plus exigeant que les autres possibilités, physiquement ou mentalement

de.#Compared to other travel options availa: Verglichen mit anderen Möglichkeiten, die Ihnen zur Verfügung stehen, zum Beispiel Gehen, Autofahren oder öffentlicher Verkehr: Wie hoch ist der gesamte Aufwand bei Ihrem üblichen Verkehrsmittel?
de.#My current mode is significantly easier: Mein derzeitiges Verkehrsmittel ist deutlich einfacher und entspannter als alle Alternativen
de.#This is a bit easier than other ways I: Es ist etwas einfacher als andere Möglichkeiten, die ich nutzen könnte
de.#Regardless of the mode the effort feels: Unabhängig vom Verkehrsmittel fühlt sich der Aufwand ungefähr gleich an
de.#This takes a bit more out of me than ot: Dieses Verkehrsmittel kostet mich etwas mehr Kraft als andere Möglichkeiten
de.#Far more demanding than alternatives (p: Deutlich anstrengender als die Alternativen, körperlich oder mental

tr.#Compared to other travel options availa: Yürüme, otomobil veya toplu taşıma gibi kullanabileceğiniz diğer seçeneklerle karşılaştırıldığında, genellikle kullandığınız ulaşım seçeneğinin gerektirdiği toplam çabayı nasıl değerlendirirsiniz?
tr.#My current mode is significantly easier: Şu an kullandığım seçenek diğer tüm alternatiflerden belirgin şekilde daha kolay ve rahat
tr.#This is a bit easier than other ways I: Kullanabileceğim diğer seçeneklerden biraz daha kolay
tr.#Regardless of the mode the effort feels: Hangi ulaşım seçeneğini kullansam da gereken çaba yaklaşık aynı
tr.#This takes a bit more out of me than ot: Bu seçenek diğerlerine göre biraz daha fazla enerji harcamamı gerektiriyor
tr.#Far more demanding than alternatives (p: Alternatiflere göre fiziksel veya zihinsel olarak çok daha yorucu

fa.#Compared to other travel options availa: در مقایسه با گزینه‌های دیگر مانند پیاده‌روی، رانندگی یا حمل‌ونقل عمومی، میزان تلاش کلی موردنیاز برای روش معمول رفت‌وآمد خود را چگونه ارزیابی می‌کنید؟
fa.#My current mode is significantly easier: روش فعلی من به‌طور محسوسی آسان‌تر و آرام‌تر از همه گزینه‌های دیگر است
fa.#This is a bit easier than other ways I: کمی آسان‌تر از روش‌های دیگری است که می‌توانم استفاده کنم
fa.#Regardless of the mode the effort feels: صرف‌نظر از روش، میزان تلاش تقریباً یکسان است
fa.#This takes a bit more out of me than ot: این روش کمی بیشتر از گزینه‌های دیگر از من انرژی می‌گیرد
fa.#Far more demanding than alternatives (p: از نظر جسمی یا ذهنی بسیار سخت‌تر از گزینه‌های دیگر است

hu.#Compared to other travel options availa: Az Ön számára elérhető más lehetőségekhez, például gyalogláshoz, autózáshoz vagy tömegközlekedéshez képest hogyan értékeli a szokásos közlekedési módjához szükséges teljes erőfeszítést?
hu.#My current mode is significantly easier: A jelenlegi közlekedési módom lényegesen könnyebb és nyugodtabb minden más lehetőségnél
hu.#This is a bit easier than other ways I: Ez egy kicsit könnyebb, mint más módok, amelyeket használhatnék
hu.#Regardless of the mode the effort feels: A közlekedési módtól függetlenül nagyjából ugyanakkora erőfeszítésnek érzem
hu.#This takes a bit more out of me than ot: Ez valamivel több energiát vesz ki belőlem, mint a többi lehetőség
hu.#Far more demanding than alternatives (p: Sokkal megterhelőbb a többi lehetőségnél, fizikailag vagy lelkileg

ar.#Compared to other travel options availa: مقارنةً بوسائل التنقل الأخرى المتاحة لك، مثل المشي أو القيادة أو النقل العام، كيف تقيّم إجمالي الجهد المطلوب لاستخدام وسيلة التنقل المعتادة لديك؟
ar.#My current mode is significantly easier: وسيلتي الحالية أسهل وأكثر راحة بوضوح من أي بديل
ar.#This is a bit easier than other ways I: هي أسهل قليلًا من الطرق الأخرى التي يمكنني استخدامها
ar.#Regardless of the mode the effort feels: بغض النظر عن الوسيلة، أشعر أن الجهد متقارب تقريبًا
ar.#This takes a bit more out of me than ot: هذه الوسيلة تتطلب مني طاقة أكبر قليلًا من الخيارات الأخرى
ar.#Far more demanding than alternatives (p: أكثر إرهاقًا بكثير من البدائل، جسديًا أو نفسيًا

schema.text: What is your approximate height?
schema.help: We ask this because height affects how well you can see and be seen in traffic and how easy it is to reach handrails, buttons and seats.

en.#We ask this because height affects how: We ask this because height affects how well you can see and be seen in traffic and how easy it is to reach handrails, buttons and seats.

it.#What is your approximate height?: Qual è approssimativamente la tua altezza?
it.#We ask this because height affects how: Lo chiediamo perché l’altezza influisce su quanto vedi e sei visto/a nel traffico e su quanto è facile raggiungere corrimano, pulsanti e sedili.

fr.#We ask this because height affects how: Nous posons cette question parce que la taille influence la façon dont vous voyez et êtes vu(e) dans la circulation, ainsi que la facilité à atteindre les barres de maintien, les boutons et les sièges.

de.#We ask this because height affects how: Wir fragen dies, weil die Körpergröße beeinflusst, wie gut Sie im Verkehr sehen und gesehen werden und wie leicht Sie Haltestangen, Knöpfe und Sitze erreichen.

tr.#We ask this because height affects how: Bunu soruyoruz çünkü boy, trafikte ne kadar iyi gördüğünüzü ve görüldüğünüzü, tutunma yerlerine, düğmelere ve koltuklara ne kadar kolay ulaştığınızı etkiler.

fa.#We ask this because height affects how: این را می‌پرسیم چون قد بر اینکه در ترافیک چقدر خوب می‌بینید و دیده می‌شوید و چقدر راحت به دستگیره‌ها، دکمه‌ها و صندلی‌ها دسترسی دارید اثر می‌گذارد.

hu.#We ask this because height affects how: Azért kérdezzük, mert a testmagasság befolyásolja, mennyire lát és látják a forgalomban, és milyen könnyen éri el a kapaszkodókat, gombokat és üléseket.

ar.#We ask this because height affects how: نسأل عن ذلك لأن الطول يؤثر في مدى قدرتك على الرؤية وأن تكون مرئيًا في حركة المرور، وفي سهولة الوصول إلى المقابض والأزرار والمقاعد.

schema.help: We ask this to take the different physical characteristics of participants into account in the study. Answering is optional and your answer is not linked to your name.

en.#We ask this to take the different physi: We ask this to take the different physical characteristics of participants into account in the study. Answering is optional and your answer is not linked to your name.

it.#What is your approximate height?: Qual è approssimativamente la tua altezza?
it.#We ask this to take the different physi: Lo chiediamo per tenere conto, nello studio, delle diverse caratteristiche fisiche di chi partecipa. Rispondere è facoltativo e la tua risposta non è collegata al tuo nome.

fr.#We ask this to take the different physi: Nous posons cette question pour tenir compte, dans l’étude, des différentes caractéristiques physiques des participants. Répondre est facultatif et votre réponse n’est pas liée à votre nom.

de.#We ask this to take the different physi: Wir fragen dies, um in der Studie die unterschiedlichen körperlichen Voraussetzungen der Teilnehmenden zu berücksichtigen. Die Antwort ist freiwillig und nicht mit Ihrem Namen verbunden.

tr.#We ask this to take the different physi: Bunu, çalışmada katılımcıların farklı fiziksel özelliklerini dikkate almak için soruyoruz. Yanıt vermek isteğe bağlıdır ve yanıtınız adınızla ilişkilendirilmez.

fa.#We ask this to take the different physi: این را می‌پرسیم تا ویژگی‌های جسمی متفاوت شرکت‌کنندگان در این مطالعه در نظر گرفته شود. پاسخ دادن اختیاری است و پاسخ شما به نام شما مرتبط نمی‌شود.

hu.#We ask this to take the different physi: Azért kérdezzük, hogy a vizsgálatban figyelembe vegyük a résztvevők eltérő testi adottságait. A válaszadás nem kötelező, és a válasza nincs összekapcsolva a nevével.

ar.#We ask this to take the different physi: نسأل عن ذلك لمراعاة اختلاف الخصائص الجسدية بين المشاركين في الدراسة. الإجابة اختيارية وإجابتك غير مرتبطة باسمك.

schema.text: What is your approximate height?
schema.help: We ask this because height can affect walking pace and how comfortable it is to use vehicles, seats and handrails. Answering is optional and your answer is not linked to your name.

en.#We ask this because height can affect w: We ask this because height can affect walking pace and how comfortable it is to use vehicles, seats and handrails. Answering is optional and your answer is not linked to your name.

it.#What is your approximate height?: Qual è approssimativamente la tua altezza?
it.#We ask this because height can affect w: Lo chiediamo perché l’altezza può influire sul passo e sulla comodità di mezzi, sedili e corrimano. Rispondere è facoltativo e la tua risposta non è collegata al tuo nome.

fr.#We ask this because height can affect w: Nous posons cette question car la taille peut influer sur le rythme de marche et sur le confort des véhicules, des sièges et des mains courantes. Répondre est facultatif et votre réponse n’est pas liée à votre nom.

de.#We ask this because height can affect w: Wir fragen dies, weil die Körpergröße das Gehtempo und die Bequemlichkeit von Fahrzeugen, Sitzen und Haltegriffen beeinflussen kann. Die Antwort ist freiwillig und nicht mit Ihrem Namen verbunden.

tr.#We ask this because height can affect w: Bunu soruyoruz çünkü boy, yürüme hızını ve araçların, koltukların ve tutunma yerlerinin kullanım rahatlığını etkileyebilir. Yanıt vermek isteğe bağlıdır ve yanıtınız adınızla ilişkilendirilmez.

fa.#We ask this because height can affect w: این را می‌پرسیم چون قد می‌تواند بر سرعت راه رفتن و راحتی استفاده از وسایل نقلیه، صندلی‌ها و دستگیره‌ها اثر بگذارد. پاسخ دادن اختیاری است و پاسخ شما به نام شما مرتبط نمی‌شود.

hu.#We ask this because height can affect w: Azért kérdezzük, mert a testmagasság befolyásolhatja a járás ütemét, valamint a járművek, ülések és kapaszkodók kényelmes használatát. A válaszadás nem kötelező, és a válasza nincs összekapcsolva a nevével.

ar.#We ask this because height can affect w: نسأل عن ذلك لأن الطول قد يؤثر في سرعة المشي وفي سهولة استخدام المركبات والمقاعد والمقابض. الإجابة اختيارية وإجابتك غير مرتبطة باسمك.

schema.text: What is your approximate height?
schema.help: We ask this to estimate the length of your step, which changes walking times. Answering is optional and your answer is not linked to your name.

en.#We ask this to estimate the length of y: We ask this to estimate the length of your step, which changes walking times. Answering is optional and your answer is not linked to your name.

it.#What is your approximate height?: Qual è approssimativamente la tua altezza?
it.#We ask this to estimate the length of y: Lo chiediamo per stimare la lunghezza del tuo passo, che cambia i tempi a piedi. Rispondere è facoltativo e la risposta non è collegata al tuo nome.

fr.#We ask this to estimate the length of y: Nous le demandons pour estimer la longueur de votre pas, qui change les temps de marche. Répondre est facultatif et votre réponse n'est pas liée à votre nom.

de.#We ask this to estimate the length of y: Wir fragen dies, um Ihre Schrittlänge zu schätzen, die die Gehzeiten verändert. Die Antwort ist freiwillig und nicht mit Ihrem Namen verbunden.

tr.#We ask this to estimate the length of y: Bunu, yürüme sürelerini değiştiren adım uzunluğunuzu tahmin etmek için soruyoruz. Yanıt vermek isteğe bağlıdır ve yanıtınız adınızla ilişkilendirilmez.

fa.#We ask this to estimate the length of y: این را می‌پرسیم تا طول گام شما را که زمان پیاده‌روی را تغییر می‌دهد تخمین بزنیم. پاسخ دادن اختیاری است و پاسخ شما به نام شما مرتبط نیست.

hu.#We ask this to estimate the length of y: Azért kérdezzük, hogy megbecsüljük a lépéshosszát, amely befolyásolja a gyaloglási időt. A válasz önkéntes, és nem kapcsolódik az Ön nevéhez.

ar.#We ask this to estimate the length of y: نسأل هذا لتقدير طول خطوتك، الذي يغيّر أوقات المشي. الإجابة اختيارية ولا ترتبط إجابتك باسمك.

Poor coordination between modes (long waiting times, missed connections)

de.#An accessible pavement, with kerb ramps: Ein barrierefreier Gehweg mit Bordsteinabsenkungen und ohne Stufen
de.#A protected space to walk at the edge o: Ein geschützter Bereich zum Gehen am Straßenrand
de.#A passage through a park, a courtyard o: Ein Durchgang durch einen Park, einen Hof oder ein brachliegendes Gelände
de.#A path shared by people walking and cyc: Ein gemeinsamer Weg für Fußgänger und Radfahrende
de.#I don't know, I just need to be able to: Ich weiß nicht, ich muss nur sicher durchkommen können

tr.#What kind of path is needed here?: Burada ne tür bir yola ihtiyaç var?

tr.#A protected space to walk at the edge o: Yol kenarında yürümek için korunaklı bir alan
tr.#A pedestrian street or area: Bir yaya sokağı veya yaya bölgesi

tr.#A path shared by people walking and cyc: Yayaların ve bisikletlilerin birlikte kullandığı bir yol

fa.#A path is any space where you can walk: منظور از مسیر هر فضایی است که بتوان در آن پیاده رفت یا دوچرخه‌سواری کرد، مانند پیاده‌رو، گذرگاه یا مسیر دوچرخه. گذرگاه راهی است که به‌جای کنار خیابان، از میان یک محوطه می‌گذرد.

fa.#A passage through a park, a courtyard o: راه عبوری از میان پارک، حیاط یا زمینی متروکه
fa.#A path shared by people walking and cyc: مسیری مشترک برای عابران پیاده و دوچرخه‌سواران

hu.#A protected space to walk at the edge o: Védett sáv a gyalogláshoz az út szélén
hu.#A passage through a park, a courtyard o: Átjáró egy parkon, udvaron vagy elhagyott területen át
hu.#A path shared by people walking and cyc: Gyalogosok és kerékpárosok által közösen használt út
hu.#I don't know, I just need to be able to: Nem tudom, csak biztonságosan át kell tudnom jutni

options.text: I don't feel safe at all
I avoid travelling in the evening because I don't feel safe
I don't travel in the evening or after dark

en.#We ask this to understand how safe peop: We ask this to understand how safe people feel while travelling. Answering is optional and your answer is not linked to your name.
en.#I don't feel safe at all: I don't feel safe at all
en.#In the evening or after dark, how safe: In the evening or after dark, how safe do you feel from crime or harassment on your usual trip?
en.#I avoid travelling in the evening becau: I avoid travelling in the evening because I don't feel safe
en.#I don't travel in the evening or after: I don't travel in the evening or after dark

it.#We ask this to understand how safe peop: Lo chiediamo per capire quanto le persone si sentono al sicuro durante gli spostamenti. Rispondere è facoltativo e la tua risposta non è collegata al tuo nome.
it.#I don't feel safe at all: Non mi sento per niente al sicuro
it.#I feel completely safe: Mi sento del tutto al sicuro
it.#In the evening or after dark, how safe: Di sera o quando è buio, quanto ti senti al sicuro da criminalità o molestie durante il tuo spostamento abituale?
it.#I avoid travelling in the evening becau: Evito di spostarmi di sera perché non mi sento al sicuro
it.#I don't travel in the evening or after: Non mi sposto di sera o quando è buio

fr.#We ask this to understand how safe peop: Nous posons cette question pour comprendre à quel point les gens se sentent en sécurité lors de leurs déplacements. Répondre est facultatif et votre réponse n’est pas liée à votre nom.
fr.#I don't feel safe at all: Je ne me sens pas du tout en sécurité
fr.#I feel slightly safe: Je me sens un peu en sécurité
fr.#I feel moderately safe: Je me sens moyennement en sécurité
fr.#I feel very safe: Je me sens très en sécurité
fr.#I feel completely safe: Je me sens totalement en sécurité
fr.#In the evening or after dark, how safe: Le soir ou à la nuit tombée, à quel point vous sentez-vous en sécurité face à la criminalité ou au harcèlement lors de votre trajet habituel ?
fr.#I avoid travelling in the evening becau: J’évite de me déplacer le soir parce que je ne me sens pas en sécurité
fr.#I don't travel in the evening or after: Je ne me déplace pas le soir ni à la nuit tombée

de.#We ask this to understand how safe peop: Wir fragen dies, um zu verstehen, wie sicher sich Menschen unterwegs fühlen. Die Antwort ist freiwillig und nicht mit Ihrem Namen verbunden.
de.#I don't feel safe at all: Ich fühle mich überhaupt nicht sicher
de.#In the evening or after dark, how safe: Wie sicher fühlen Sie sich abends oder bei Dunkelheit auf Ihrem üblichen Weg vor Kriminalität oder Belästigung?
de.#I avoid travelling in the evening becau: Ich meide Wege am Abend, weil ich mich nicht sicher fühle
de.#I don't travel in the evening or after: Ich bin abends oder bei Dunkelheit nicht unterwegs

tr.#We ask this to understand how safe peop: Bunu, insanların yolculuk sırasında kendilerini ne kadar güvende hissettiklerini anlamak için soruyoruz. Yanıt vermek isteğe bağlıdır ve yanıtınız adınızla ilişkilendirilmez.
tr.#In the evening or after dark, how safe: Akşamları veya hava karardıktan sonra olağan yolculuğunuzda suça veya tacize karşı kendinizi ne kadar güvende hissediyorsunuz?
tr.#I avoid travelling in the evening becau: Kendimi güvende hissetmediğim için akşamları yolculuk yapmaktan kaçınıyorum
tr.#I don't travel in the evening or after: Akşamları veya hava karardıktan sonra yolculuk yapmıyorum

fa.#We ask this to understand how safe peop: این را می‌پرسیم تا بفهمیم مردم هنگام رفت‌وآمد چقدر احساس امنیت می‌کنند. پاسخ دادن اختیاری است و پاسخ شما به نام شما مرتبط نمی‌شود.
fa.#In the evening or after dark, how safe: در عصر و شب یا پس از تاریک شدن هوا، در سفر معمول خود چقدر در برابر جرم یا آزار احساس امنیت می‌کنید؟
fa.#I avoid travelling in the evening becau: از رفت‌وآمد در شب پرهیز می‌کنم چون احساس امنیت نمی‌کنم
fa.#I don't travel in the evening or after: در عصر و شب یا پس از تاریکی رفت‌وآمد نمی‌کنم

hu.#We ask this to understand how safe peop: Azért kérdezzük, hogy megértsük, mennyire érzik magukat biztonságban az emberek közlekedés közben. A válaszadás nem kötelező, és a válasza nincs összekapcsolva a nevével.
hu.#In the evening or after dark, how safe: Este vagy sötétedés után mennyire érzi magát biztonságban bűncselekményekkel vagy zaklatással szemben a szokásos útja során?
hu.#I avoid travelling in the evening becau: Kerülöm az esti közlekedést, mert nem érzem magam biztonságban
hu.#I don't travel in the evening or after: Este vagy sötétedés után nem közlekedem

ar.#We ask this to understand how safe peop: نسأل عن ذلك لنفهم مدى شعور الناس بالأمان أثناء تنقلهم. الإجابة اختيارية وإجابتك غير مرتبطة باسمك.
ar.#In the evening or after dark, how safe: في المساء أو بعد حلول الظلام، إلى أي مدى تشعر بالأمان من الجريمة أو التحرش في تنقّلك المعتاد؟
ar.#I avoid travelling in the evening becau: أتجنب التنقل في المساء لأنني لا أشعر بالأمان
ar.#I don't travel in the evening or after: لا أتنقل في المساء أو بعد حلول الظلام

schema.text: How much does the visual quality of your surroundings (e.g., architecture, public spaces, or overall atmosphere) influence your travel experience?

options.text: Not at all, I do not pay attention to the visual environment
Slightly, I notice the surroundings, but they rarely affect my experience
Moderately, pleasant or unpleasant surroundings sometimes affect my mood during travel
Strongly, the visual environment significantly affects my travel experience
Very strongly, I sometimes choose routes because they are visually appealing or interesting

en.#How much does the visual quality of you: How much does the visual quality of your surroundings (e.g., architecture, public spaces, or overall atmosphere) influence your travel experience?
en.#Not at all, I do not pay attention to t: Not at all, I do not pay attention to the visual environment
en.#Slightly, I notice the surroundings, bu: Slightly, I notice the surroundings, but they rarely affect my experience
en.#Moderately, pleasant or unpleasant surr: Moderately, pleasant or unpleasant surroundings sometimes affect my mood during travel
en.#Strongly, the visual environment signif: Strongly, the visual environment significantly affects my travel experience
en.#Very strongly, I sometimes choose route: Very strongly, I sometimes choose routes because they are visually appealing or interesting

it.#How much does the visual quality of you: Quanto influisce la qualità visiva dell'ambiente circostante (ad es. architettura, spazi pubblici o atmosfera generale) sulla tua esperienza di viaggio?
it.#Not at all, I do not pay attention to t: Per niente, non presto attenzione all'ambiente visivo
it.#Slightly, I notice the surroundings, bu: Poco, noto l'ambiente circostante, ma raramente influisce sulla mia esperienza
it.#Moderately, pleasant or unpleasant surr: Moderatamente, un ambiente piacevole o sgradevole a volte influisce sul mio umore durante lo spostamento
it.#Strongly, the visual environment signif: Molto, l'ambiente visivo influisce significativamente sulla mia esperienza di viaggio
it.#Very strongly, I sometimes choose route: Moltissimo, a volte scelgo determinati percorsi perché sono visivamente piacevoli o interessanti

fr.#How much does the visual quality of you: Dans quelle mesure l’aspect visuel de votre environnement, par exemple l’architecture, les espaces publics ou l’ambiance générale, influence-t-il votre expérience de déplacement ?
fr.#Not at all, I do not pay attention to t: Pas du tout : je ne fais pas attention à l’aspect visuel de mon environnement
fr.#Slightly, I notice the surroundings, bu: Un peu : je remarque mon environnement, mais il influence rarement mon expérience
fr.#Moderately, pleasant or unpleasant surr: Modérément : un environnement agréable ou désagréable influence parfois mon humeur pendant le trajet
fr.#Strongly, the visual environment signif: Beaucoup : l’aspect visuel de l’environnement influence fortement mon expérience de déplacement
fr.#Very strongly, I sometimes choose route: Énormément : il m’arrive de choisir certains itinéraires parce qu’ils sont beaux ou intéressants

de.#How much does the visual quality of you: Wie stark beeinflusst die optische Qualität Ihrer Umgebung, zum Beispiel Architektur, öffentliche Räume oder die allgemeine Atmosphäre, Ihr Erlebnis unterwegs?
de.#Not at all, I do not pay attention to t: Gar nicht — ich achte nicht auf die optische Umgebung
de.#Slightly, I notice the surroundings, bu: Etwas — ich bemerke meine Umgebung, aber sie beeinflusst mein Erlebnis nur selten
de.#Moderately, pleasant or unpleasant surr: Mäßig — eine angenehme oder unangenehme Umgebung beeinflusst manchmal meine Stimmung
de.#Strongly, the visual environment signif: Stark — die optische Umgebung beeinflusst mein Erlebnis unterwegs deutlich
de.#Very strongly, I sometimes choose route: Sehr stark — manchmal wähle ich Wege, weil sie schön oder interessant sind

tr.#How much does the visual quality of you: Çevrenizin görsel kalitesi, örneğin mimari, kamusal alanlar veya genel atmosfer, yolculuk deneyiminizi ne kadar etkiler?
tr.#Not at all, I do not pay attention to t: Hiç etkilemez — çevrenin görünümüne dikkat etmem
tr.#Slightly, I notice the surroundings, bu: Biraz etkiler — çevreyi fark ederim ama deneyimimi nadiren etkiler
tr.#Moderately, pleasant or unpleasant surr: Orta düzeyde etkiler — hoş veya hoş olmayan çevre bazen yolculuk sırasındaki ruh halimi etkiler
tr.#Strongly, the visual environment signif: Çok etkiler — çevrenin görünümü yolculuk deneyimimi belirgin şekilde etkiler
tr.#Very strongly, I sometimes choose route: Çok güçlü etkiler — bazen güzergâhları daha güzel veya ilgi çekici oldukları için seçerim

fa.#How much does the visual quality of you: کیفیت ظاهری محیط اطراف، مانند معماری، فضاهای عمومی یا حال‌وهوای کلی، تا چه اندازه بر تجربه سفر شما اثر می‌گذارد؟
fa.#Not at all, I do not pay attention to t: اصلاً؛ به ظاهر محیط توجه نمی‌کنم
fa.#Slightly, I notice the surroundings, bu: کمی؛ محیط را می‌بینم، اما به ندرت بر تجربه من اثر می‌گذارد
fa.#Moderately, pleasant or unpleasant surr: تا حد متوسط؛ محیط خوشایند یا ناخوشایند گاهی بر حال من در سفر اثر می‌گذارد
fa.#Strongly, the visual environment signif: زیاد؛ ظاهر محیط به‌طور قابل توجهی بر تجربه سفر من اثر دارد
fa.#Very strongly, I sometimes choose route: خیلی زیاد؛ گاهی مسیرها را به دلیل زیبا یا جالب بودن انتخاب می‌کنم

hu.#How much does the visual quality of you: Mennyire befolyásolja a környezet látványa, például az építészet, a közterek vagy az általános hangulat az utazási élményét?
hu.#Not at all, I do not pay attention to t: Egyáltalán nem — nem figyelek a környezet látványára
hu.#Slightly, I notice the surroundings, bu: Kissé — észreveszem a környezetet, de ritkán befolyásolja az élményemet
hu.#Moderately, pleasant or unpleasant surr: Közepesen — a kellemes vagy kellemetlen környezet néha befolyásolja a hangulatomat utazás közben
hu.#Strongly, the visual environment signif: Erősen — a környezet látványa jelentősen befolyásolja az utazási élményemet
hu.#Very strongly, I sometimes choose route: Nagyon erősen — néha azért választok útvonalat, mert szép vagy érdekes

ar.#How much does the visual quality of you: إلى أي مدى يؤثر شكل البيئة المحيطة بك، مثل العمارة أو الأماكن العامة أو الجو العام، في تجربة تنقلك؟
ar.#Not at all, I do not pay attention to t: لا يؤثر إطلاقًا — لا أهتم بالشكل العام للبيئة
ar.#Slightly, I notice the surroundings, bu: يؤثر قليلًا — ألاحظ البيئة المحيطة لكنها نادرًا ما تؤثر في تجربتي
ar.#Moderately, pleasant or unpleasant surr: يؤثر بدرجة متوسطة — البيئة الجميلة أو غير المريحة تؤثر أحيانًا في مزاجي أثناء التنقل
ar.#Strongly, the visual environment signif: يؤثر كثيرًا — شكل البيئة يؤثر بوضوح في تجربة تنقلي
ar.#Very strongly, I sometimes choose route: يؤثر كثيرًا جدًا — أختار أحيانًا بعض الطرق لأنها جميلة أو مثيرة للاهتمام

schema.text: Do you walk as a primary mode of travel at least once a week? (This means walking as the main way to complete a trip, not just short transfers between other modes.)

en.#Do you walk as a primary mode of travel: Do you walk as a primary mode of travel at least once a week? (This means walking as the main way to complete a trip, not just short transfers between other modes.)

it.#Do you walk as a primary mode of travel: Ti sposti a piedi come modalità principale di viaggio almeno una volta alla settimana? (Ciò significa camminare come modalità principale per completare uno spostamento, non solo per brevi trasferimenti tra altri mezzi.)

fr.#Do you walk as a primary mode of travel: Marchez-vous comme principal mode de déplacement au moins une fois par semaine ? (Cela signifie que la marche est le principal moyen d’effectuer le trajet, et pas seulement un court trajet pour rejoindre un autre mode de transport.)

de.#Do you walk as a primary mode of travel: Gehen Sie mindestens einmal pro Woche zu Fuß als Hauptverkehrsmittel? (Gemeint ist, dass Sie den größten Teil des Weges zu Fuß zurücklegen und nicht nur kurze Wege zum Umsteigen.)

tr.#Do you walk as a primary mode of travel: Haftada en az bir kez yürümeyi ana ulaşım şekli olarak kullanıyor musunuz? (Yani yolculuğun büyük bölümünü yürüyerek tamamlamak; yalnızca başka bir ulaşım seçeneğine ulaşmak veya aktarma yapmak için kısa yürüyüşler değil.)

fa.#Do you walk as a primary mode of travel: آیا حداقل هفته‌ای یک بار پیاده‌روی روش اصلی رفت‌وآمد شماست؟ (یعنی بیشتر سفر را پیاده انجام می‌دهید، نه فقط مسیر کوتاه برای رسیدن به وسیله دیگر یا تعویض وسیله.)

hu.#Do you walk as a primary mode of travel: Gyalogol fő közlekedési módként legalább hetente egyszer? (Ez azt jelenti, hogy az út nagy részét gyalog teszi meg, nem csak rövid szakaszokat más közlekedési módok eléréséhez vagy átszálláshoz.)

ar.#Do you walk as a primary mode of travel: هل تستخدم المشي كوسيلة رئيسية للتنقل مرة واحدة على الأقل في الأسبوع؟ (أي أن المشي هو الوسيلة الأساسية لإكمال معظم الرحلة، وليس فقط لمسافات قصيرة للوصول إلى وسيلة أخرى أو للتبديل بينها.)
